notes: The placement of *for* on the benefactive לְ of לוֹ is sound under rule 11: a present function morpheme whose sense the word carries takes it before a construction does. The competing reading is rule 19's, which would give *for* to סְגֻלָּה as the construct relation recast; the unit's note records the contest.
לְ of לְעַם is unrepresented under rule 40, the predicative phrase being written bare as *a people*; the suffix takes the emphatic *his own* whole under rule 18.

The rectum הָאֲדָמָה is rendered arthrously, so nothing is fronted: the article takes the *the* before its own word and פְּנֵי takes a supplied one (rule 29). The article on הָעַמִּים is unrepresented, no *the* being written for *all peoples*.
